lines.3: I looked at the clock. Eight thirty.
lines.4: That woke me up in a hurry.
lines.5: 「Crap, I forgot to set my alarm.」
lines.7: Oh, right. This was because we'd stayed up late shooting the breeze.
lines.8: 「Hey, wake up. We're on a straight course for being late.」
lines.10: 「Then why not roll with it? Let's take our time and show up around third period.」
lines.11: 「The worst part is, we can still make it if we run. I'm going.」
lines.12: 「Fine, fine. I'll go change. Meet me downstairs in five minutes, and wake Crab up.」
lines.13: I hurriedly crammed down breakfast--some bread we'd stocked up on and such.
lines.15: 「Another wild bear was lured by food into a private residence and has this time been shot and killed.」
lines.16: That bear was really pushing its luck.
lines.17: I dashed over to the Kanisawa house next door.
lines.19: 「Would you like to take that thing off my hands as your bride?」
lines.20: 「I'd rather not marry a girl who can chug a liter and a half of cola in one go.」
lines.21: 「Fair enough. If I were a man, I wouldn't want her either.」
lines.22: 「More importantly, we're about to be late. Couldn't you wake your daughter up?」
lines.23: 「Too much trouble. Waste of time. She's old enough to look after herself.」
lines.24: No good. Her mother had completely given up on her.
